blocks.name: Holo — calculer 3×3
steps: In Google Chrome, open a new tab and go to https://www.google.com. In the search bar, type « calculatrice » and press Enter. The Google calculator should appear in the results. Click the « 3 » button, then the « × » button, then the « 3 » button, then the « = » button. Read the result displayed on the calculator screen.

expect.resultat: the number displayed as the result of 3 × 3 on the calculator

blocks.name: Holo — saisir 9 dans Notion
steps: In Google Chrome, switch to the tab that has the Notion page « Résultat des calculs » open (app.notion.com). Click in the page body where the list of results is. Type « {{Holo — calculer 3×3.resultat}} » and press Enter to add it as a new line. Do not modify any other content on the page.

blocks.name: Holo — calculer 3÷3
steps: In Google Chrome, switch back to the tab with the Google calculator. Click the « C » (clear) button to reset the calculator. Then click the « 3 » button, then the « ÷ » button, then the « 3 » button, then the « = » button. Read the result displayed on the calculator screen.

expect.resultat: the number displayed as the result of 3 ÷ 3 on the calculator
